name: Woodbridge
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Woodbridge, VA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Woodbridge, Virginia for 2026: the Holiday Walk of Lights at Neabsco, Santa photos, library story time and a Nutcracker.
lede: Woodbridge families get a free light walk at Neabsco Regional Park, Santa photos at Chinn Aquatics and a story time with Santa at Lake Ridge Library.
celebrates: Woodbridge's season is spread across county parks, libraries and a recreation center. Prince William County hosts the Holiday Walk of Lights at Neabsco Regional Park from December 1 to 30, Santa visits Lake Ridge Library on December 15 and the Chinn Aquatics and Fitness Center holds free Photos with Santa on December 19. The SBDCRC School of Dance performs The Nutcracker: After Midnight at Gar-Field Senior High School the same afternoon. Rippon Lodge Historic Site opens its decorated rooms for Holidays through the Ages on select days from December 4 to 28.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Woodbridge's holiday events, so this page sticks to the 2026 schedule from the county and the hosts.
facts: The Walk of Lights is set on the Neabsco Creek Boardwalk at Neabsco Regional Park, and its schedule includes a Sensory Night on Tuesday, December 1, from 5 to 8 pm. Lake Ridge Library's Santa story time is geared to babies up to age 6, and the park closes December 24 to 27.
trains: Woodbridge has a Virginia Railway Express station, and VRE's Santa Trains on Saturday, December 12, 2026, board at Woodbridge as well as Manassas, Burke Centre, Fredericksburg and Spotsylvania. Tickets are $10 per rider and sold online only starting November 30. Occoquan's town dock, a short drive away, also hosts Santa's arrival by boat.
traditions: A free light walk along the Neabsco Creek Boardwalk.
Free photos with Santa on December 19.
A free family story time at Lake Ridge Library on December 15.
A student dance recital at Gar-Field Senior High School.
kidfact: The Walk of Lights has a Sensory Night on December 1 for children who prefer a quieter, calmer visit.
faq: Are there Christmas events for kids in Woodbridge?

Yes. For 2026 we list the Holiday Walk of Lights at Neabsco Regional Park, Santa Visits Family Story Time at Lake Ridge Library, Photos with Santa at Chinn Aquatics and The Nutcracker: After Midnight.
Is the Neabsco Walk of Lights free?
Yes. The Holiday Walk of Lights runs December 1 to 30, most Tuesday to Sunday evenings from 5 to 9 pm, and is closed December 24 to 27.
Does Woodbridge have a Santa Train?
VRE's Santa Trains run Saturday, December 12, 2026, and the schedule lists Woodbridge among the boarding stations. Tickets are $10 per rider, online only.
Can children meet Santa for free in Woodbridge?
Yes. Photos with Santa at Chinn Aquatics and Fitness Center on December 19 from 2 to 4 pm and the Lake Ridge Library story time on December 15 are both listed as free.
Is there a historic holiday tour in Woodbridge?

Yes. Prince William County Parks and Recreation runs Holidays through the Ages at Rippon Lodge Historic Site, 2150 Silversmith Court, for $5. It is open 10 am to 3 pm on December 4 to 7, 11 to 14, 18 to 21 and 26 to 28, with groups of 15 and guided tours at 11 am and 2 pm.
sources: Prince William County Parks and Recreation
